title: Extract fieldwork::media module with DB queries
description:
Now that fieldwork owns the schema, extract media processing WITH persistence into fieldwork.

Source: GJ media.rs (482 lines, has GIF frame bomb check).

Module split:
1. Pure logic (no DB):
   - sniff_mime(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<&str> — magic byte MIME detection (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP)
   - validate_image(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<ImageInfo> — dimensions, GIF frame count (500 max), file size
   - process_image(bytes: &[u8], max_dim: u32) -> Result<ProcessedImage> — resize, strip EXIF, generate blurhash
   - ImageInfo, ProcessedImage structs

2. Persistence (uses fieldwork::db::Pool):
   - insert_media(pool, media: &MediaRow) -> Result<i64>
   - get_media(pool, id: i64) -> Result<Option<MediaRow>>
   - attachments_for_post(pool, post_id: i64) -> Result<Vec<MediaRow>>
   - MediaRow struct matching canonical media table

Deps: image, blurhash (optional, behind 'media' feature), sqlx via db-postgres/db-sqlite.

Fixes: Adds GIF frame bomb protection to smallhold (was missing). All three projects get identical media handling.
